clue.text: Eccentric chap's description of pre-Ordovician Wales?

parts.note: an eccentric is a kind of cam, an off-centre wheel in machinery
Brian is a chap's name; the 's links it to what follows

explanation.surface: An odd fellow describes Wales as it was in deep geological time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eccentric' looks like an adjective for the chap, but in engineering an eccentric is a CAM; the chap is BRIAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Cambria is the old name for Wales, and the Cambrian period immediately precedes the Ordovician in geological time.

clue.text: Ride fast, going away at first — then head back

indicators.note: at first asks for the opening letters of the two preceding words, going and away
back says the word for head is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: poll is an old word for the head, as in a poll tax

explanation.surface: A rider sets off at speed, then turns their horse's head for home.
explanation.definitionFit: To gallop is to ride a horse at its fastest pace.

clue.text: Cleaner endlessly serving parliament

indicators.note: endlessly means the word for cleaner loses its final letter

parts.note: a daily is a British term for a cleaning lady who comes in each day

explanation.surface: A cleaning woman works at the legislature without a break.
explanation.walkthrough: A DAILY (British for a daily cleaner) loses its end.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dáil is the lower house of the Irish parliament, the Oireachtas.

clue.text: Agent — one originally boosting every Aussie holiday venue

parts.note: James Bond is the archetypal secret agent
the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: originally points to the first letter of boosting

parts.note: every means each

explanation.surface: A spy and a sole helper promote a favourite Australian resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Bondi Beach is a famous Sydney beach, a popular destination for holidaymakers in Australia.

clue.text: Loose cash bishop invested in beer: not always the same

parts.note: coins in the pocket are loose change

indicators.note: invested in says the bishop's letter is put inside the word for beer

parts.note: ale is a type of beer
B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A bishop puts his spare coins into beer, a habit that varies.
explanation.definitionFit: Something changeable varies, so it is not constant from one time to the next.

clue.text: Tudor composer, and how he travelled from London to Lincoln?

definitions.meaning: William ... was an English composer of the Tudor period

definitions.text: how he travelled from London to Lincoln?
definitions.meaning: read as by road, abbreviated to by plus the abbreviation for road

explanation.surface: A Tudor musician and the route he took between two English cities.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the name as BY RD: RD is the standard abbreviation for road, so it says he went by road.
explanation.definitionFit: William Byrd is one of the best known Tudor composers of church music.

clue.text: In greener resort, see person getting own back

indicators.note: In says the letter for see goes inside the rearranged letters
resort read as re-sort means the letters of greener are sorted again

parts.note: V stands for vide, Latin for see, used in references

explanation.surface: Visitors at a leafier holiday spot are told to look around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday place but is re-sort, the anagram indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: A revenger takes vengeance, paying someone back for a wrong done.

clue.text: The present writer's aim to start with something like chicory

indicators.note: to start with says the word for aim goes at the front

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal
the present writer is I, so the present writer has is I've

explanation.surface: A writer declares that their goal is a vegetable like chicory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The present writer' is a standard way for a setter to say I; with the 's for has it gives I'VE.
explanation.definitionFit: Endive is a leafy salad plant closely related to chicory.

clue.text: Like some courts putting a case together

parts.note: a case in court is a trial

explanation.surface: A lawyer assembles a case for the courts.
explanation.walkthrough: Courts here are courtyards: an atrium is a central court, so atrial describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Atrial relates to atria, the open central courts of Roman houses and buildings.

clue.text: What a druggy may smoke in front of this northern plant

indicators.note: in says the smoked item sits inside the letters from this and northern
front of asks for the first letter of the word this

parts.note: a reefer is a cannabis cigarette

explanation.surface: A drug user lights up beside a plant from the north.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree fern is a large fern with a tall trunk-like stem.

clue.text: Hesitant exhortation starting race, therefore?

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitation
go is the call that starts a race

explanation.surface: A starter dithers before shouting for the race to begin.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergo is Latin for therefore, used to introduce a conclusion.

clue.text: Composer I found in church with right lighting fixture

indicators.note: found in says the composer and I are placed inside the letters for church and right

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
George Frideric Handel was a Baroque composer

explanation.surface: A composer is discovered in church beside the proper light fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A chandelier is an ornate hanging light with several branches.

clue.text: People who moan about trendy TV programmes?

indicators.note: about says the moaners go around the word for trendy

parts.note: a misery is a gloomy complaining person
in means fashionable

explanation.surface: Grumblers complain about fashionable television.
explanation.definitionFit: A miniseries is a television drama shown in a small number of episodes.

clue.text: Hairstyle primarily adhered to? The opposite

indicators.note: primarily asks for the first letter of adhered

parts.note: the opposite of to is fro, as in to and fro

explanation.surface: A hairstyle is stuck to the head, or the reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: An Afro is a rounded bushy style of natural curly hair.

clue.text: Report of type searched for

indicators.note: Report of says the word for type is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a sort is a type or kind

explanation.surface: A report on a kind of thing that was hunted down.
explanation.definitionFit: Sought is the past tense of seek, meaning looked for.

clue.text: Exercise nurse finally picking up rubbish, say, in ward

indicators.note: picking up says the exercise letters take in the rubbish and example

parts.note: PE is physical exercise
rot is nonsense or rubbish
eg means for example, which is what say means here

indicators.note: finally asks for the last letter of nurse

explanation.surface: A nurse on a hospital ward does exercises and clears up litter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ward' looks like a hospital ward but means a person in someone's care.
explanation.definitionFit: A protégée is a woman under the protection or guidance of a patron, like a ward.

clue.text: Heartless about arresting party workers? Shame!

indicators.note: arresting means holding, so the trimmed word grips the party and workers
Heartless means the central letters of about are removed

parts.note: a bash is a party
men are workers, as in a workforce

explanation.surface: A disapproving cry at a party held for workers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartless' strips BOU, the middle letters, from ABOUT, leaving AT, which then grips BASH and MEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Abashment is embarrassment, a feeling of shame or discomfort.

clue.text: Surplus the unstable may lose before fall

definitions.meaning: the remainder of an account, what is left over

definitions.text: the unstable may lose before fall
definitions.meaning: unsteady people lose their equilibrium just before they tumble

explanation.definitionFit: A balance is the amount remaining, and also the steadiness one loses before falling.

clue.text: Charge that is brought about medic at university?

indicators.note: brought about says the words for that is go around the doctor and university

parts.note: ie stands for id est, that is
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: A doctor at college is accused, or so it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: To imbue is to fill or permeate, as one charges something with feeling.

clue.text: Name a new type of slightly leavened bread

explanation.surface: A naming of a new kind of bread.
explanation.definitionFit: Naan is a South Asian flatbread, leavened lightly and baked in a tandoor.

clue.text: Arthur's wife, always welcomed by most of country

indicators.note: welcomed by puts the word for always inside the shortened country
most of drops the last letter of the country

parts.note: Guinea is a country in West Africa
ever means always

explanation.surface: King Arthur's queen is always well received in her homeland.
explanation.definitionFit: In Arthurian legend the queen married to King Arthur is Guinevere.

clue.text: Lazy type's song embracing several different keys

indicators.note: embracing says the song wraps around the musical keys

parts.note: a lied is a German art song
E, A and B are three musical keys

explanation.surface: A slacker's song moves through a number of keys.
explanation.definitionFit: A lie-abed is someone who stays in bed late, an idler.

clue.text: Eg Hammerstein's very large estate?

definitions.note: the definition names Hammerstein's first name, the possessive pointing to something belonging to him

parts.note: OS is outsize, a clothing size
an estate is a type of car

explanation.surface: A lyricist owns a vast landholding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'estate' suggests land but is an estate car; Oscar Hammerstein II was the lyricist of Rodgers and Hammerstein.
explanation.definitionFit: Hammerstein the lyricist bore the given name Oscar, so it is an example of his name.

clue.text: Cloth cap suffering rat bite?

indicators.note: suffering signals that the letters of rat bite are damaged and rearranged

explanation.surface: A flat cap that has been gnawed by a rat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cloth cap' suggests a working man's flat cap, but the cloth is the clergy.
explanation.definitionFit: A biretta is the square cap worn by Roman Catholic clergy, the cloth.

clue.text: Warbler taking breather under cape — or above

indicators.note: above in a down clue places the gold on top
under in a down clue puts the breather beneath the cape

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
C is the map abbreviation for cape
a rest is a breather

explanation.surface: A singing bird pauses below a headland or on top of it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' looks like a link word but is the heraldic word for gold.
explanation.definitionFit: The goldcrest is a tiny European songbird of the kinglet family, once grouped with the warblers.

clue.text: Green hill accommodating third of prehistoric bones

indicators.note: accommodating means the green and hill take in a letter

parts.note: vert is green in heraldry
brae is a Scottish word for a hillside

indicators.note: third of asks for the third letter of prehistoric

explanation.surface: A green hillside holds ancient bones.
explanation.definitionFit: Vertebrae are the bones that make up the spine.

clue.text: Island group gathers cricket side — it's pressing!

indicators.note: gathers means the group surrounds the cricket side

parts.note: a ring is a group or gang
the on side is the leg side of a cricket field

explanation.surface: An island chain takes in a cricket team, which is urgent.
explanation.walkthrough: The on side in cricket is the half of the field behind the batsman's legs.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironing is pressing clothes flat with a hot iron.

clue.text: Initially feeling overwhelmed, English girl ups and leaves

indicators.note: Initially asks for the first letters of feeling and overwhelmed
ups in a down clue means the following letters are read upwards

parts.note: Gail is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl from England, overwhelmed by emotion, gets up and walks out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ups and leaves' looks like a girl walking out; leaves is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Foliage is the leaves of plants collectively.

clue.text: Character abroad fencing in wild beast

indicators.note: fencing means enclosing, so the Greek letter surrounds in

parts.note: rho is a letter of the Greek alphabet, a foreign character

explanation.surface: A foreign character is fencing with a wild animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhinoceros is a large wild animal with a horned snout.

clue.text: Party in lead is Conservative

annotationWithheld.why: Party in lead is Conservative (5) for DISCO: D(IS C)O needs DO for party, but 'Party' is the definition and 'lead' gives no letters, so a word does two jobs

clue.text: Current political leader set up as mischief-maker

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current

indicators.note: set up in a down clue means the leader's letters are turned upside down

parts.note: PM is the prime minister

explanation.surface: The present prime minister is cast as a troublemaker.
explanation.definitionFit: An imp is a small mischievous sprite, a troublemaker.
